decisions.reason: Hudson Rock analysis of Remus Stealer marketing claims; no demonstrated capability, no victims, no CVE. Vendor hype about an infostealer sales pitch.

Substantive vendor patch reporting: Ivanti 13 flaws (CSA CVE-2026-121683 CVSS 9.4, EPM CVE-2026-121653 CVSS 9.8 SQLi to pre-auth RCE, Sentry/EPMM CVE-2026-105425) plus six Citrix fixes with named affected versions.

CVE-2026-121653.evidence: Unauthenticated SQL injection leading to RCE with public advisory detail, but Ivanti states no evidence of in-the-wild exploitation.

decisions.reason: Critical FortiClient endpoint flaw CVE-2026-121529 (advisory FG-IR-26-194) reported by Kevin Joensen of Baldur Security, exploitable through a malicious website. Distinct enough from the enterprise appliance advisory batch to hold as its own story.

CVE-2026-121529.evidence: Researcher-reported website-triggered code execution with an advisory and finder named; no observed exploitation reported.

decisions.reason: Corroborates the Able2Shell cluster: N-able declared a major outage on November 9 and reports increased scanning for N-central hosts after PoC publication. Same incident, not a new story.

CVE-2026-86218.evidence: N-able took hosted N-central environments offline and reports increased scanning against vulnerable servers following public proof-of-concept code; honeypot exploitation attempts reported but no confirmed customer compromise.

decisions.reason: Proofpoint BluePhishing is research proof-of-concept only; the source explicitly states no in-the-wild activity has been identified. Thin single-outlet note with no CVE.

Standalone Microsoft out-of-band disclosure on November 10, 2026 of two Important Active Directory flaws (CVE-2026-119948 RCE, CVE-2026-105559 DoS) with low-privilege, no-interaction vectors. Not part of the November Patch Tuesday roundup coverage.

CVE-2026-119948.evidence: Microsoft rates it Important with a low-privilege attack vector and no user interaction, but the report cites no observed exploitation.

decisions.reason: Collector teaser post for a GhostFrame ESXi blog; no primary technical detail, single aggregator source, and no feed corroboration.

CVE-2026-81648 already has an existing story with advisory sources; this post names the same missing-authorization flaw in CryptoPayment Gateway 1.2.1 through 1.2.2. Attach as corroboration, do not mint.

CVE-2026-81648.evidence: Rated critical (CVSS 10) for a missing authorization check across versions 1.2.1 to 1.2.2; no observed exploitation is claimed in the cited advisories.

decisions.reason: SPH Media breach disclosure corroborating the existing single-source story on the cyberattacks against its internal systems.
MIRE/C3 honeypot traffic statistics, not a security event.

CVE-2026-116606.evidence: Posted as an actively exploited authentication bypass in Barracuda Email Security Gateway; the existing story already carries this CVE among the tracked Barracuda flaws.
